shortDescription: List and filter on Node Balancer Types.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Node Balancer Types to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Node Balancer Types.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Node Balancer Types in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Node Balancer Types by.
